Titan cordless 18V combi drill delivering 35Nm torque, with drill, hammer, and screwdriver modes. Drills through 30mm wood and 10mm steel with ease. Features 2 speeds, keyless chuck and LED worklight. Soft grip handle for comfort. Supplied with 15 drill bits, 9 driver bits, socket adaptor and magnetic bit holder. Part of the Titan TXP 18V battery system (battery sold separately).
